Many affected individuals also have vision loss caused by changes in the light-sensitive tissue that lines the back of the eye (the retina). Learning disabilities and developmental delays are often seen in children with NARP, and older individuals with this condition may experience a loss of intellectual function (dementia). Other features of NARP include seizures, hearing loss, and abnormalities of the electrical signals that control the heabeat (cardiac conduction defects).
